title: Codegen race - Mode 1: fork, Java AST route (legacy-BC bytes)
command: java -cp "demo/harness/codegen/target/classes;demo/harness/codegen/target/lib/*" demo.harness.codegen.Main generate --mode m1 --src "demo/corpus/cdm-5.38.0;demo/corpus/iso20022-1.38.0;demo/corpus/drr-6.34.1" --builtins demo/corpus/builtins --out demo/work/gen-m1 --filter all
notes: Cold codegen race: N=3 runs per mode, FRESH JVM each run, output tree deleted before every run (outside the measured window; wallMs is self-reported inside the JVM: RuntimeMXBean start time -> last file written, so JVM boot is included). Runs interleaved round-robin across the four modes (legacy,m1,m2,m3 per round) so background drift spreads evenly. Headline wallMs/jvmStartToFirstFileMs/peakRssMb are MEDIANS of the valid runs; every run is in metrics.runs. peakRssMb = PeakWorkingSet64 sampled every 150 ms by the outer wrapper. Process priority BelowNormal; no other JVM ran concurrently. Warm dependency state: jars already on disk (this measures codegen, not downloads).
